$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/twenty-connector - the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol section 4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. The four gate contexts below are exactly the contexts this repository's main ruleset (baseline-protection) requires, each carrying the reusable workflow it calls and the 40-character sha this repository's OWN caller pins for it; the truthful-attribution-gate context carries its callerPath and allowedEvents together with the reusable workflow it calls and the 40-character engine sha its caller's uses: line pins (that caller is itself a high-risk path), so the merge road reads the engine pin from this suite. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (config/high-risk-defaults.json, highRiskGlobs; the engine's classifyHighRisk fails closed unless the effective set is a superset); it is the UNION of the central defaults at BOTH engines that read it - the one this repository's attribution caller pinned at the suite's birth (8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2, 28 globs; the caller now pins 1e40675e1642dcc32d195f27b3deb285b4d3d6fc, whose defaults are the same 35 globs) and the one the merge road is written against (416a75707fdcfeb768b41c3a54f944078d1ab8fc, 35 globs, which adds the docs-publish-pipeline class) - so the effective set is a superset for either engine; this repository adds nothing of its own beyond that union, because the two additions it would need - ".github/**" and "**/gate-suite.json" - are already central defaults, and the repository carries no release or publish script of its own (its only release path, .github/workflows/release.yml, is covered by ".github/**", and scripts/twenty-bootstrap/ is CRM bootstrap/cutover operator tooling, not a release or publish road). High-risk changes (this file is itself one - see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the section-4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-11-14 re-audit: all 6 requiredContexts exist at main - actions-pinned-gate.yml, gitignore-gate.yml, source-leak-gate.yml, secret-scan-gate.yml, extension-conformance-gate.yml, truthful-attribution-gate.yml - and the caller jobs with the called jobs of the same ids produce the declared context names; pins 4c903fe9 (actions-pinned-gate), 4c903fe9 (gitignore-gate), 00ac7b92 (source-leak-gate), a8677e50 (secret-scan-gate), 2cf48c6c (extension-conformance-gate), 1e40675e (truthful-attribution-gate) equal their callers' uses: SHAs and, where the caller passes one, its ref: input (the secret-scan-gate caller passes no ref: input); the extension-conformance-gate callerPath equals that caller's own path and its allowedEvents (pull_request, push) equal that caller's triggers (pull_request, push); the truthful-attribution-gate callerPath equals that caller's own path and its allowedEvents (pull_request, push, merge_group) cover that caller's triggers (pull_request, push), merge_group declared with no such trigger; 1e40675e is a supported engine SHA of the merge road (grant revision 2) and the attribution caller runs the same commit; the central high-risk defaults read version 2026.06 with 35 globs at each of the nine supported engine SHAs and all 35 are in the 35 highRiskPaths (none missing; 0 repository extensions); accountable unchanged (Sandro Groganz, sandro@cinatra.ai, groganz); recorded, not changed: the active branch ruleset requiring actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate, kind-gates, secret-scan-gate, source-leak-gate, and every suite context concluded success at the main head read. Commands: checkout reads of the suite and its callers, git reads of the called reusable workflows at their pins and of config/high-risk-defaults.json at each supported engine, ruleset and check-run reads. Only lastAuditedAt and auditEvidence changed; the version stays, as an audit refresh changes no context, pin or high-risk path.
